3. By this application under section 438 Cr.P.C., the petitioner namely, Krishna Page No.# 2/3 Kamal Chutia is praying for pre-arrest bail as he is apprehending arrest in connection with Dhemaji P.S. Case No. 94/2023, under sections 344/376(1)384/406 of I.P.C.

sentences.text: 4. I have considered the submissions at the bar.

5. The allegations against the petitioner is that on 10.05.2023, the petitioner deceitfully called the victim on his house and finally took her along with her minor daughter to Sivasagar and thereafter to Guwahati and thereafter the petitioner confined the victim and committed rape on her forcibly and snatched away mobile phone and cash of Rs. 25,000/- from her and confined her for 17 days.
Later on, the victim somehow managed to escape on 27.05.2023 and lodged the F.I.R. against the petitioner.

6. It is submitted at the bar that the victim had eloped with the petitioner and both the victim and the petitioner are married but the victim eloped with the petitioner and now false case has been lodged against the petitioner at the behest of the victim's husband.
7. To consider the bail petition case diary is necessary.

Call for the case diary by fixing 14.08.2023.
8.

In the interim and in the event of arrest, the petitioner namely, Krishna Kamal Chutia, shall be enlarged on bail on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand) with one suitable surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority, in connection with Dhemaji P.S.
Case No. 94/2023, under sections 344/376(1)384/406 of I.P.C.
8.

The bail is granted on the following conditions:
1. That the petitioner will refrain from such activities with which he is alleged;
2. that the petitioner will appear before the I.O within 7 days from Page No.# 3/3 the date of this order and co-operate with the investigation.
3. that the petitioner shall not leave the territorial jurisdiction without prior permission; and 4. the petitioner will not hamper or tamper with the evidence or exercise threats to any witnesses.
